rationale: The candidate upgraded Probot and the source compiles, but the final verifier runs Jest and all tests fail at runtime. The decisive failure is a behavior/API interaction mismatch: the app tries to fetch the config via a URL/path that the tests do not match, producing Nock errors for `.github%2Fautoapproval.yml`. The agent also introduced broad runtime monkeypatches for Probot and node-fetch instead of a clean migration, but the observed verifier failure is the resulting incorrect runtime behavior rather than a compile or install failure.

evidence.quote: Test command failed with exit code 1
HttpError: request to https://api.github.com/repos/dkhmelenko/autoapproval/contents/.github%2Fautoapproval.yml failed, reason: Nock: No match for request
Intercept node-fetch globally in node require cache.
